content._: History — my memory, automatic; a counting block. The kernel writes one lossless leaf per wake. Entries land by APPEND — never compute a slot: the substrate allocates the next zero-free number (1..9, 11..19, …, 99, 111…) and supernests at each all-nines boundary, wrapping the past under this underscore where its addresses keep reading zero-padded, the count continuing and never restarting. Nothing is ever cleared. Every zero-carrying number is a summary slot, never an entry: N0 is the voicing of container N and carries a +0 summary of the PREVIOUS completed nine — 10 over 01-09, 20 over 11-19, 100 over 10-90, 110 over 91-99. A summary is NAVIGATION, not decoration: a substantive paragraph dense with the span's own handles — proper nouns, block addresses, decisions, failures, open threads, the read-addresses of load-bearing leaves — because summaries stack (100 compresses 10-90; 1000 compresses those) and a descending reader must find at every layer the exact keywords that choose the next span, down to the leaf. Owed when the next span opens; paid by the requesting LLM via the fold's summary field (service-payment, reported at conditions:9 until paid). Paying one means writing N0 as the whole container — the new underscore beside its digit children resent — because a bare string at N0 replaces the container. The spindle through the newest leaf carries the summary chain. Never written by hand — deliberate notes go to stash.
